title: chock baseline
description: Where a tree stood when `chock baseline` last ran. Ratchet gates compare against it and fail only when a number gets worse. Belongs in git, and moves on the main branch deliberately.

chock.description: The chock that recorded these numbers, so a reader can tell whether a change in them is a change in the tree or in the measure.

gates.description: One series per ratchet gate. Keys within a series are that gate's own: a file path, a function, or the name of a measure. binsize, bsize, coverage and mutest measure differently on each system, so macOS and Windows keep theirs as `<gate>@macos` and `<gate>@windows`.

additionalProperties.description: Lower is better, always. A gate trips when a key's measurement exceeds this.

units.description: What each gate was counting when it was recorded. A gate that changes unit keeps its keys, so no key check catches it and the new numbers read as a regression. Absent in a baseline written before chock kept them, which cannot be checked rather than being a mismatch.
